layman_headline: I cannot make a prediction—my data systems are critically broken
layman_explanation: My market data connections have failed completely. I have no technical indicators for most coins, no macro economic data, no DeFi metrics, no funding rates, and no volume analysis. The few signals I can see are contradictory and incomplete. Making a trade recommendation with this level of data failure would be pure gambling disguised as analysis.
layman_action: Wait for my systems to recover before considering any trades. Do not act on incomplete information.
expert_reasoning: CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE FAILURE: This analysis request reveals catastrophic data degradation across all key systems. (1) Macro data: completely empty—no M2 money supply, no interest rates, no dollar strength index. (2) Technical indicators: RSI missing on 2/7 coins, MACD universally null, moving average data sparse or absent. (3) Funding rates: null across entire watchlist—cannot assess leverage positioning. (4) Volume analysis: 'volume_vs_avg' null on all candidates—cannot confirm breakouts. (5) DeFi TVL changes: all showing 0% 7-day change, indicating stale or broken data feeds. (6) Messari metrics: empty objects across all coins. This represents 60-70% data loss across critical decision inputs. Per my validated rules #3 and #6, I require at least 60-70% data availability before issuing any trading signal. Current availability is approximately 30%. Rule #1 explicitly states I must refuse predictions rather than default to HOLD when systems fail. My previous 'accurate' predictions were accidents caused by exactly this type of failure—I defaulted to HOLD with 0% confidence instead of refusing to predict, and market conditions happened to align with inaction. That was not analytical skill; it was broken infrastructure producing random alignment. Proceeding would repeat that error and prevent learning which signals actually matter.
